entries.316f62a2feb654e6: The company’s mission is to provide products that meet end users’ needs for “safe, reassuring, delicious, inexpensive and easy-to-cook products,” and its basic strategy is to develop high value-added products to avoid price competition. It will work on restructuring the Boneless Fish Business through the new “ＭＯＴＴＯ” series and on expanding sales of livestock meat products produced in Thailand.

entries.6f9c3ed1caa8368f: The company operates a single segment, specializing in wholesale of business-use frozen foods. By business, Other Business, which includes side dishes and frozen vegetables, is the largest, followed by Boneless Fish Business and Meat Business. About 55% of products depend on partner factories overseas, of which about 40% are at production sites in China, so the company identifies as an issue the diversification of production through expanding its bases in Thailand and Vietnam and shifting part of production to Japan.
entries.70945c1ba6f8eb14: It sells to end users and wholesalers in Japan, including medical meal services, bento and catering businesses and restaurants. Storage and logistics are outsourced to external providers, and the company has built a delivery system that enables next-day delivery from a single case (1 case).
entries.7583b97362b313cf: This is the company's core business division, handling "boneless fish" from which all fish bones have been removed, for medical and nursing-care meals. The company succeeded in developing it in 1998 and holds four manufacturing patents for its processing technology. X-ray inspection for residual bones is carried out, and as of March 2026 it offers 32 fish species. Revenue by business for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥8,713 million.
entries.7bd620e5422beab1: This is a business division handling livestock meat products that apply the processing technology of "boneless fish."
entries.7f39de92437e7bed: Its strength lies in its processing technology for boneless fish. It holds four manufacturing patents for processing that allows products to be cooked from frozen and to stay tender even after cooling, and ensures safety through X-ray inspection for residual bones and an information traceability system. Product development is handled by a dedicated Special Product Development Project, which directly incorporates end users’ requests.
entries.810bff0eecfe692b: The company is headquartered in Chuo-ku, Tokyo. The company does not prepare consolidated financial statements, and the number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 146.

entries.9669e0bf47612ae4: The company is headquartered in Chuo-ku, Tokyo. It does not prepare consolidated financial statements and has a single segment, the wholesale of frozen foods for commercial use. It plans frozen foods for commercial use and, as a fabless company, outsources their manufacture to partner factories in Japan and overseas that meet its own inspection standards, selling its own-brand products and PB products for specific users. The number of employees as of March 31, 2026 is 146. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
